args.command:
cat > make.py <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
s='CC(C)(C)C(=O)O[C@@H](c1ccccc1)c1c([Ni][Si](C)(C)C)cc2ccccc2c1'
m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(s)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
print('CIP',[(a.GetIdx(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode')) for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.HasProp('_CIPCode')])
m=Chem.AddHs(m)
p=AllChem.ETKDGv3();p.randomSeed=23;p.useRandomCoords=False;p.useMacrocycleTorsions=True
print(AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,p))
conf=m.GetConformer()
with open('initial.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{m.GetNumAtoms()}\ninitial, S stereochemistry\n')
 for a in m.GetAtoms():
  v=conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx())
  f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol()} {v.x:.8f} {v.y:.8f} {v.z:.8f}\n')
PY
python make.py

python - <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D
lines=open('answer.xyz').read().splitlines(); xyz=lines[2:]
s='CC(C)(C)C(=O)O[C@@H](c1ccccc1)c1c([Ni][Si](C)(C)C)cc2ccccc2c1'
m=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(s))
conf=Chem.Conformer(m.GetNumAtoms())
for i,l in enumerate(xyz):
 p=list(map(float,l.split()[1:4]));conf.SetAtomPosition(i,Point3D(*p))
m.AddConformer(conf)
# clear chiral then infer from structure
for a in m.GetAtoms():
 if a.GetChiralTag()!=Chem.ChiralType.CHI_UNSPECIFIED: a.SetChiralTag(Chem.ChiralType.CHI_UNSPECIFIED)
Chem.AssignAtomChiralTagsFromStructure(m,replaceExistingTags=True)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
for a in m.GetAtoms():
 if a.HasProp('_CIPCode'): print(a.GetIdx(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode'),a.GetChiralTag())
PY
